name: Pro Planet P4
summary: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P4 is an elegant 8-stage RO water purifier with SCMT, UV LED, and Alkaline Min-Tech technology, delivering Baby-Safe, mineral-rich drinking water while saving up to 2X more water with its 5-Star rated Advanced Recovery Technology.
intro: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P4 is a premium 8-stage RO water purifier featuring Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT), UV LED in-tank purification, and Alkaline Min-Tech for safe, mineral-rich drinking water. Its 5-Star water-saving technology, digital display, and elegant design deliver 24×7 Baby-Safe, Earth-Safe purified water, making it ideal for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources.
notes: Alkaline Min-Tech, Digital Display, Intelli-Display, Night Assist, All Time Fresh UV Purification, High Water Saving (5-Star Rated)
